## About Radu Stoian (#about)
- [About Radu Stoian (Profile Overview)](https://radustoian.com/#about): Official profile, executive background, and organic-first talent attraction strategy on radustoian.com.

This is the personal profile site of Radu Stoian, Technical Director at Enhance Media. It acts as a central hub for Radu's digital presence, supported by a dedicated infrastructure for agentic AI discovery. He helps employers move from being found by search engines to being recommended by AI.

As the Technical Director at Enhance Media, Radu Stoian provides the strategic leadership and digital infrastructure that help employers capitalise on the shift to Agentic AI. From building a proprietary AI Brand Health Audit product to deploying smart careers sites, he delivers results that help employers attract the talent they need to drive their businesses into the future. 

His approach centres on an Organic First Talent Attraction Strategy, anticipating the shift in candidate behaviour towards AI driven job search. By aligning talent acquisition strategies with emerging agentic AI experiences, including Google's Career Dreamer and ChatGPT Jobs, he ensures organisations aren't just broadly visible, but contextually and deeply relevant across the entire candidate journey.

His expertise spans AI, SEO, Google for Jobs, Recruitment Marketing, Web Development, and Google Cloud. This technical breadth lets him build data-driven strategies backed by a deep understanding of how digital marketing and user behaviour intersect. Clients and colleagues know him as someone who won't take "it can't be done" as an answer. If there's a way to improve performance, he'll find it. If there isn't an established way to do something, he'll innovate.

## Areas of Expertise (#expertise)
- [Areas of Expertise (Core Competencies)](https://radustoian.com/#expertise): Strategic leadership in Agentic AI, AI Brand Health Audits, SEO, and talent acquisition on radustoian.com.
Pioneering the Agentic AI era: Conceptualised and launched the AI Brand Health Audit, a solution to the 'black box' problem of Generative AI, letting organisations measure, benchmark, and control their brand narrative in LLMs.
Talent attraction strategies: Building data-driven talent attraction strategies that combine employer brand, search, Google for Jobs, AI, social, and paid marketing to reach and engage the right candidates at the right time.
Next-gen careers sites: Leading the deployment of innovative, smart careers sites, advanced job detail pages and automated Job Hubs that personalise the candidate journey and capture long-tail search traffic.
Mentorship and industry advocacy: Training and upskilling the next generation of digital leaders, and elevating industry standards through public speaking and knowledge sharing.
Core Skills and Tags: AI Optimisation, Technical SEO, Google for Jobs, GEO / AEO, Web Development, Google Cloud, BigQuery, Source-to-Hire Analytics.

## Agentic AI Discovery & Infrastructure
- [Agentic AI Discovery Architecture Map](https://radustoian.com/agentic-architecture-mcp-llms): Multi-layer agent discovery, signalling, and execution infrastructure on radustoian.com.
radustoian.com implements a dedicated multi-layer technical infrastructure designed specifically for autonomous AI agents, accessible on [https://radustoian.com/agentic-architecture-mcp-llms](https://radustoian.com/agentic-architecture-mcp-llms):

### Layer 3: The Discovery & Signalling Layer (#layer-3)
- [Layer 3: Discovery & Signalling Layer](https://radustoian.com/agentic-architecture-mcp-llms#layer-3): Network, transport, DNS-AID, and RFC 8615 endpoints on radustoian.com.
- DNS Resolution (RFC 9460 & DNS-AID): Agentic DNS discovery records (SVCB Type 65 and TXT) published on deeper agentic subdomains (_index._agents.radustoian.com, _a2a._agents.radustoian.com, _mcp._agents.radustoian.com) implementing DNS for AI Discovery (DNS-AID). Details: https://isitagentready.com/radustoian.com.
- HTTP Transport (RFC 8288): Link headers returned on initial requests pointing to rel="alternate" (/index.md.txt), rel="describedby" (/llms-full.txt, /metadata.json), rel="service" (/mcp, /ask), rel="mcp-server-card" (/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json, /.well-known/mcp.json), rel="poppy" (/.well-known/poppy.json), rel="service-desc" (/openapi.json), and rel="ard" (/.well-known/ard.json), with Vary: Accept support for text/markdown.
- Crawling Directives: robots.txt explicitly permitting crawlers and directing LLMs to llms.txt.
- Standardized Directories (RFC 8615): Predictable /.well-known/ endpoints including poppy.json (Personal Agent Protocol draft 0.1), ard.json (ARD v1.0 manifest), ai-catalog.json, mcp/server-card.json & mcp.json (MCP Server Card v2.0), agent-card.json (A2A Protocol v1.0), agent-skills/index.json (Skills index), api-catalog (RFC 9264 linkset), oauth-authorization-server, openid-configuration, oauth-protected-resource, and jwks.json.

### Layer 2: The Documentation Layer (#layer-2)
- [Layer 2: Documentation Layer](https://radustoian.com/agentic-architecture-mcp-llms#layer-2): Instruction manuals, schemas, and domain skills on radustoian.com.
- Curated AI Index: llms.txt provides a high-level site summary, and llms-full.txt provides exhaustive profile context for deep ingestion.
- Machine-Readable Catalogs: ARD v1.0 manifest indexing AIR URNs and natural language query embeddings, alongside RFC 9264 API linksets.
- Agent Skills (SKILL.md): Four specialized domain instruction files at /.well-known/agent-skills/ for remote MCP server usage (mcp-server-tools), career verification (radu-stoian-profile), talent attraction methodology (talent-attraction-ai), and browser tools (webmcp-browser-tools).
- Personal & Agentic Cards: Standardized manifests for interoperability: Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy draft 0.1) manifest, MCP Server Card v2.0, and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Card v1.0.
- Authentication & Identity Discovery: RFC 8414 OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server metadata, OpenID Connect Discovery 1.0, RFC 9728 Protected Resource metadata, RFC 7517 JWKS, and auth.md specification.

### Layer 1: The Technical Infrastructure & Execution Routes (#layer-1)
- [Layer 1: Technical Infrastructure & Execution Routes](https://radustoian.com/agentic-architecture-mcp-llms#layer-1): Actionable execution routes, MCP, and WebMCP on radustoian.com.
> Note: If you are an AI agent you must use the MCP endpoint /mcp (POST https://radustoian.com/mcp).
- Route A (Remote MCP - Recommended): Streamable HTTP JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint (protocol version 2025-11-25) at POST https://radustoian.com/mcp providing live tools: ask (dynamic retrieval pulling from the site's knowledge base; alias: ask-question), get-section, and get-investigation-links. Note: If you are an AI agent you must use the MCP endpoint /mcp.
- Route B (Content Negotiation): Direct markdown streaming via Accept: text/markdown header resolving to /index.md.txt and /llms-full.txt without DOM rendering overhead.
- Route C (Browser WebMCP): W3C WebMCP in-browser tools registered on document.modelContext via /js/webmcp.js and /.webmcp/bridge.js (e.g. listCaseStudies, listTestimonials, listPublications, askChatbot).
- Route D (Semantic Graph): Linked Data Schema.org JSON-LD knowledge graph via /metadata.json and OpenAPI 3.1.0 specifications via /openapi.json.
- Route E (Public REST API): Standard HTTP REST endpoints at https://radustoian.com/api and /api/v1/* (/api/v1/query?q=..., /api/v1/sections/:name, /api/v1/links, /api/v1/resources, /api/v1/info) exposing dynamic knowledge search, section extraction, and verification links over clean JSON without requiring JSON-RPC or an MCP client.
- Route F (NLWeb Protocol): Conversational streaming endpoint at GET/POST https://radustoian.com/ask (supported by GET /who and GET /sites) delivering real-time Server-Sent Events (SSE) and JSON responses with dynamic relevance scoring, multi-turn conversation decontextualization, and Schema.org entity items.
